strategy_roster.name: Premarket Gap MomoTrader
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(close,1) >= 5 and close > open and (close - open) / (high - low) > 0.75 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1
strategy_roster.notes: The documented MinGainPct 5 gap, green candle, large body (the lowest 75% sizing tier is used as the entry filter) and MinVolume 15000 are kept, with the absolute volume threshold expressed as volume above its 20-bar average. The exit is the documented first red candle or non-increasing volume, and the 04:00-09:30 session filter, one-trade-per-day rule and volume-based sizing need clock and order state.

strategy_roster.name: Macd Pattern Trader Trigger
strategy_roster.notes: The histogram double-bottom above zero is approximated by a positive MACD histogram that is rising over three bars, and the mirror (negative histogram) is the exit; 12/26/9 is an explicit default since the docs only say the lengths replicate the original advisor. Bullish/Bearish Trigger and Reset levels, point-based stop and target and automatic reversal are stateful features.

strategy_roster.name: ADX CCI MA
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,10),ema(close,20)) and adx(high,low,close,10) > 20 and zscore(close,15) > 1.5 and close > sma(close,200)
strategy_roster.notes: Documented AdxLength 10 with AdxThreshold 20, CciPeriod 15 (CCI > 100 mapped to 1.5 z-score units) and the Simple MaLength 200 trend filter are used; +DI crossing -DI is approximated by a fast/slow EMA cross since directional indices are not exposed. StopLossPercent 1 and TakeProfitPercent 2 are the documented percentage protections, and the optional MA risk exit is disabled by default.

strategy_roster.name: Artificial Intelligence Perceptron
strategy_roster.notes: The Accelerator Oscillator is rebuilt exactly (AO of median price minus its SMA) and, because the perceptron weights X1-X4 and the 7-bar input spacing are undocumented and cannot be shifted in the DSL, the single positive AC reading stands in for a positive perceptron output. The 850-point stop, break-even move and volume-increasing reversal are position state.

strategy_roster.name: FlexiMA Variance Tracker
strategy_roster.entry_long: close - sma(close,20) > sma(close - sma(close,20),20) + std(close - sma(close,20),20) and close > ema(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: The deviation series around the documented MA length 20 is compared with its own 20-bar average plus one standard deviation (the documented 1.0 multiplier), and SuperTrend direction is proxied by close above EMA(20). Exit is the opposite deviation, and the documented ATR period 10 / factor 3.0 sizing filter and the absence of stops are noted.

strategy_roster.name: Gold ORB
strategy_roster.notes: The 00:00-06:00 Asia range is approximated by a prior 6-bar high/low (6 hours of the documented session) and closing beyond it is the breakout entry, with the opposite side as the exit. The range-derived stop and the 2.0 RewardMultiplier target cannot be expressed as fixed percentages, and the session clock windows are unavailable on daily bars.

strategy_roster.name: OpenPendingorderAfterPositionGetStopLoss
strategy_roster.notes: The stochastic %K slope turning up is rebuilt as the 14-bar range-position line crossing its 3-period average (KPeriod 14 / DPeriod 3 are explicit defaults) and the downward turn exits. Pending stop placement above market, per-direction position caps, point-based protection and reinstalling orders after a stop-out are order-book features.

strategy_roster.name: N Candles v3
strategy_roster.notes: A run of identical-direction candles is measured with bars_since, giving three consecutive bullish bars for the long and three bearish bars for the exit; Identical Candles has no documented value so 3 is an explicit default. The position cap, point-based take-profit/stop-loss and trailing step are order and position state.

strategy_roster.name: Coin Flip Martingale
strategy_roster.notes: Entries are decided by a pseudo-random coin toss on each finished candle with no market signal, so the impossible negative-price guard is used instead of a fabricated rule. Martingale sizing, the price-step stop/target and the trailing activation are position-management features the DSL cannot express.

strategy_roster.name: Stochastic Histogram
strategy_roster.notes: The %K line is approximated by the close's position in the 14-bar range with a 3-period %D average, and the documented Cross-mode contrarian rule (long on a downward %K/%D cross) is used since Mode is not fixed. KPeriod, DPeriod, Slowing and the Levels thresholds HighLevel/LowLevel have no documented values, so the Cross mode defaults 14/3 are used and the Levels branch is dropped.
